identity: Dendro Slime / 草史莱姆 (official small species)
observed_anatomy: Actual HoYoWiki reference has low soft green body, pale lower belly, irregular upper green patches, two pale warm-bordered eyes without mouth, fern-like lobed leaves and curled tendrils. No flower cap.
identity_review: Recognizable small Dendro Slime; lobed leaf silhouette, curled stems, mouthless two-eye face and green-to-pale body preserved. Three leaves are more upright than compact right-hand pose, but same species reference includes this upright arrangement. Not invented medium or poison species.
small_size_review: 106/127px pair of warm eyes and lobed leaf crown remain clear. Thin curls merge; green body stays distinct from rocky brown hatchling.
edge_limitation: Low-alpha fringe/specks extend farther than visible solid silhouette. Raw alpha preserved. Small preview is not native antialiasing/crop safety proof; later native adaptation should test 6% inset contain without trimming.
